stored_body.rendered_markdown:
**Verdict.** Zavi can send marketing email from zaviagent.com today, and authentication isn't the blocker. The gap is lifecycle: every send so far went to a 5-person test list, and no welcome sequence exists.

**This week (about 1.5 hours, founder).** 10 minutes to confirm the From address, about 1 hour to load the 3-email welcome sequence into SendGrid and attach it to account creation.

**Do first.** Check the From address is on zaviagent.com, not www (details below).

**Honesty line.** I read your lists and public DNS today. Nothing has been sent by today's check, and nothing sends without your approval.

### Authentication, read today from public DNS
- **DMARC:** present. `v=DMARC1; p=none; rua=mailto:41a685cff0884071ac445184da95dd20@dmarc-reports.cloudflare.net;`. Policy is monitor-only, and `rua=` is set, so failures are visible. Moving to `p=quarantine` is a later step once the reports look clean.
- **SPF:** present. `v=spf1 include:_spf.google.com ~all`. Soft fail, Google only, and well under the ten-lookup limit. SendGrid isn't in the apex SPF. That is fine only if SendGrid authenticates through DKIM, which it appears to.
- **DKIM:** `s1._domainkey.zaviagent.com` is a CNAME to `s1.domainkey.u55870032.wl033.sendgrid.net`. That is the SendGrid domain-authentication record. I did not check `s2`, and I can't confirm SendGrid shows the domain as verified.
- **Not verifiable from outside:** one-click unsubscribe headers (RFC 8058) and the spam complaint rate. Check the complaint rate in Google Postmaster Tools, last 30 days, and keep it near 0.1% and well under 0.3%. Your saved SendGrid unsubscribe group (36207) should cover the unsubscribe header.

### Lists, read today
- Zavi list "Testing": 5 people, 5 can be emailed, 0 unsubscribed or bounced. Zavi reports "Bulk email is not set up yet" and no From address on this route.
- SendGrid audience "test": 5 members.
- I could not read opens, clicks or complaints. Recent sends were approved today, and no results were read, so there are no engagement numbers to quote.
- Scoreboard: no recorded outcomes or experiments in the window. That means nothing has been tracked through Zavi here, not that nothing works.

### Capture surface
The homepage (one fetch only) shows account signup ("Get started", "Free to start. No card, no sales call.") and no newsletter or waitlist form. I did not run a second check, so I can't say none exists. The destination for this channel is account creation, and the sequence below points there. The promise made is the free plan, so the welcome emails stay on onboarding. Don't send launch blasts to these addresses unless the signup flow says marketing email is included.

### Lifecycle gap
There is no welcome sequence. Three one-off sends went to the test list today (all approved). Each new account getting nothing after signup is the message with the highest attention you're missing. Per-account activation data wasn't read, so I'm not sizing the gap.

### The welcome sequence
See the card. Trigger: account created. Stop rule: anyone who adds their website leaves the sequence. Track the CTA link in SendGrid, so next month's run can tell whether it moved anyone to add a website.

**If you only do one thing:** confirm the From address, then load Email 1.

step.body: Email 1 on account creation, Email 2 on day 3, Email 3 on day 7. Stop rule: anyone who adds their website leaves the sequence. The footer uses the postal address you saved in Settings; confirm it is a mailing address you want public. Success is observable without open rates: new accounts adding a website after clicking, and replies. Stop if the first 100 recipients produce no clicks and any unsubscribes, and rethink the copy. Send only to accounts that created an account, with a working unsubscribe.
